params.body:
## Why

The photo tab of the vehicle sheet was the last big Bootstrap island there: the two galleries
were `.row` + `col-xl-2/col-lg-3/col-md-4/col-6` with `p-2` as the gutter, and every tile action
was a `.btn btn-circle-sm btn-circle btn-<colour>` from the bought theme, restyled afterwards by
`refresh.css`. That layer only makes sense as long as the theme classes are there, so the markup
and the rules that key on them have to move together.

Behaviour is unchanged. Every id, name, data attribute, event handler and JS hook class is kept
and the elements stay in the same order; only layout and colour classes changed. Photo URLs still
come from `VehicleImageService::urlVoor()` untouched, and nothing is built while a page renders.

One thing this made visible: `col-xl-2` never did anything. purgecss drops the theme's
`@media (min-width: 1200px)` block, so a wide screen already showed four tiles per row and not
six. The new grid says four, which is what the dealer actually sees.

## What per view

- `_tabs/photos.blade.php` — the gallery `<ul>` becomes `ui-photo-grid`, the `<li>`
  `ui-photo-cell` (the grid carries the gutter, so no cell padding and no `ui-state-default`
  left over from jQuery UI). Toolbar buttons become `ui-button` / `ui-button--primary` /
  `ui-button--danger`; the "duplicate" button keeps its quiet white look (`btn-warning` was
  already white in the house style). The processing notice becomes `ui-processing-note`. The
  video block loses its `.row`/`col-sm-12` and gets the `ui-field` shape used on the other
  panes: label above the field instead of beside it, which on a phone left the field a sliver.
- `_tabs/photos/image.blade.php` — the four overlay buttons become `ui-tile-btn`
  (`--primary` for the wand, `--danger` for delete); the wrapper, the labels and the
  `ba-*` structure are untouched.
- `_tabs/photos/sl_image.blade.php` — same three buttons, same treatment.
- `_tabs/photos/stocklist.blade.php` — the platform gallery gets the same grid and cell, and
  the two bulk buttons become `ui-button` variants.

## JS hooks kept

`existing_images`, `existing_stocklist_images`, `existing_image`, `existing_image_{id}`,
`existing_image_title`, `image_checkbox`, `image_stocklist_checkbox`, `heeft-achtergrond`,
`ui-fotoview-wrap`, `ui-filter-bg`, `trans_button`, `edit_button`, `copy_button`,
`remove_button`, `remove_image`, `spinner-grow`, `removeBgPhotosButton`,
`duplicatePhotosButton`, `removePhotosButton`, `removebg_selected`, `removebg_sl_selected`,
`duplicate_selected`, `delete_selected`, `car_images`, `ownstock_stocklist_photos`,
`vehicles_are_being_processed`, `ba-pair` / `ba-cel` / `ba-img` / `ba-acties` / `ba-meer`,
`data-id`, `data-processing`, and the `video_url[...]` field names. Sorting
(`$(".existing_images").sortable(...)`), polling (`#existing_image_{id}` replaced with
`photos.image` / `photos.sl_image`) and the Livewire island behind `wire:ignore` all keep
working on the same selectors.

## CSS

- Added: `.ui-photo-grid` / `.ui-photo-cell` (the grid that replaces the Bootstrap columns),
  `.ui-tile-btn` with `--primary` and `--danger`, `.ui-processing-note`.
  `.ui-tile-btn` reproduces exactly what the theme plus `refresh.css` produced today: 40x40,
  8px radius, quiet white with an ink icon, blue for the wand, red on hover for delete. The
  platform gallery's own rule keeps shrinking them to a 30px circle on the photo.
- Rekeyed to `.ui-tile-btn`: the hover-reveal rule on `.existing_image`, the `.ba-acties`
  overlay rules (desktop and the phone "is-open" row) and the platform-tile placement rules.
  The `.btn` half of those selectors stays, because other screens still use `.existing_image`
  with theme buttons.
- Removed: `.ui-edit .existing_images > li.ui-state-default`, which only neutralised the grey
  ground of a class the markup no longer carries.

## Screenshots

Photo tab before/after at 1280 and 390 (own-offer gallery, platform gallery, videos), rendered
against the same stylesheets the app loads. Tile geometry and colours measured identical:
wand `rgb(10,143,212)`/white, edit and duplicate white/ink, delete white/grey, 40x40 at 8px in
the own gallery and 30x30 round on the platform tiles; tile width 286px at 1280 in both.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` + `php -l` on every compiled view
- `npm run build`
- `SmokeTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|VehicleForm|Vehicle|Photo|Damage|DemoMedia`: 231 tests green (1 skipped)
params.title: Photo tab of the vehicle sheet in the ui vocabulary
